description: BLIND-SPOT CLOSURE R7 -- multi-word topic keys miss the HeldAnswer bridge. world_adapter._topic_facts (the frame-based NP extraction the general topic route reads) and shadow_focus (read_clause's own head-only reduction) both reduce a multi-word proper-noun topic to its HEAD noun -- e.g. 'wright'/'brothers' for 'the Wright brothers' -- which never matches the HeldAnswer bridge's key, the deep reader's OWN multi-word entity name ('wright_brothers', minted at document ingest by _mint_document_held_answers off the SAME coref_entities naming convention). world_adapter._shadow_read_turn now records that richer signal mechanically as shadow_doc_topic on the Message, BEFORE any tick() runs this turn: does one of THIS turn's newly-minted SmEntities carry a name that equals an EXISTING HeldAnswer topic -- a graph fact (two independent reads of the SAME deterministic entity-naming function landing on the same string), never a new NP-span heuristic. THIS seed is the DECISION: when shadow_doc_topic is present, it names the true topic, and wins over whatever (possibly head-truncated) guess route_question_to_topic's own comp_topic carries -- so route_shadow_topic_to_answer mints the SAME Goal{kind:answer_topic} shape route_question_to_topic mints, keyed on the richer name. Because shadow_doc_topic is a pre-tick Message attribute (written by the adapter before either rule's engine pass), route_question_to_topic's own NEW deferral guard (mirroring its existing 'your/yours possessive' deferral precedent: 'Not shadow_doc_topic present') is a static precondition check, not an install-order race -- the two rules never double-mint for the same message regardless of seed load order.
